sql: with o as (select lo.id, lo.status, (select t.contracts_ahead from live_order_queue_ticks t where t.live_order_id=lo.id and t.contracts_ahead is not null order by t.captured_at limit 1) ahead, (select max(t.rest_seconds) from live_order_queue_ticks t where t.live_order_id=lo.id) rs from live_orders lo where lo.strategy='Fmmsell10' and lo.kalshi_order_id is not null and lo.status in ('filled','canceled')) select case when ahead is null then 'z_no_reading' when ahead=0 then 'a_front(0)' when ahead<=50 then 'b_1-50' when ahead<=500 then 'c_51-500' when ahead<=5000 then 'd_501-5000' else 'e_5000+' end bucket, count(*)::text n, count(*) filter (where status='filled')::text filled, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status='filled')/nullif(count(*),0))::text pct, percentile_disc(0.5) within group (order by rs) filter (where status='filled')::text med_fill_secs from o group by 1 order by 1
